title: The Truth About Max Towing Numbers (What the Brochure Does Not Say)
description:
Thirteen thousand, five hundred pounds. That is the number Ford puts on the F-one-fifty, and it is true. But a Chevrolet Silverado without one option package tows about nine thousand pounds, four thousand less than its own maximum. The towing number on the brochure is a best-case number, and a very specific one. Here is what the max towing numbers really mean, truck by truck.

Sources:
We used the Autoblog comparison of the twenty twenty-six Ram one thousand five hundred, Ford F-one-fifty and Chevrolet Silverado one thousand five hundred, the GM Authority report on the twenty twenty-seven Silverado, and the Autoblog and SlashGear lists of the cheapest trucks for the smaller ones. Every source is listed in the description. And where two sources disagree, we say so.
